title: Indian Market News Brief — 02 Nov 2026 — Nifty 50
quick_read: Strong quarterly results from Reliance Industries, foreign buying in big stocks, and lower crude oil prices may support the market. However, export tax hikes on fuel, profit margin pressure from raw material costs, and bank cyber security concerns could cause pressure. Regulatory actions in China and proposed changes to insurance agent commissions leave overall market direction unclear.

stories.headline: Reliance Industries eyes growth boost from O2C, retail and Jio businesses
stories.summary: Reliance Industries reported higher profit and revenue for the July-September quarter. The oil-to-chemicals division and Jio Platforms led the growth. However, retail business profits faced pressure from investments in online commerce.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Strong growth in telecom and chemical businesses at India's largest company could boost overall market mood.

stories.headline: FPI buying returns to Dalal Street as global investors rethink AI bets
stories.summary: Foreign portfolio investors turned into net buyers of Indian equities. They purchased nearly $1.2 billion worth of shares over ten recent trading sessions, focusing mainly on big company stocks.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Renewed buying by foreign investors in large company shares provides strong support to the main stock index.

stories.headline: Oil prices fall over 1% as Iran-Qatar talks raise hopes of diplomatic progress
stories.summary: Crude oil prices dropped by over 1% following talks between Iran and Qatar. The diplomatic discussion raised hopes of lowering regional conflict.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Cheaper crude oil cuts import costs for India and helps reduce raw material expenses for many domestic companies.

stories.headline: Tax twist for OMC stocks: Indian Oil, BPCL, HPCL shares in 2 Nov focus after this decision by Govt on petrol, diesel
stories.summary: The government increased export duties on diesel and aviation turbine fuel starting October 31. At the same time, it lowered the export duty on petrol to zero.
stories.impact: May hurt Nifty: Higher export taxes on diesel and jet fuel could reduce profits for state-owned oil refiners.

stories.headline: Sun Pharma shares gain despite Q2 profit slips 36% YoY | Should you buy, sell or hold? What brokerage says, target price
stories.summary: Sun Pharma reported a 36.4% fall in net profit to ₹1,988.5 crore for the September quarter due to legal expenses and acquisition costs. However, sales revenue grew 11.9% to ₹16,198.7 crore.
stories.impact: Unclear for Nifty: One-time legal and acquisition costs hurt net profit, but steady revenue growth in India and specialty drugs provides support.

stories.headline: Cyberattacks on banks, including AU Small Finance Bank, worry insurers as claim risks rise
stories.summary: AU Small Finance Bank is investigating a possible customer data leak stored on third-party software. Insurance companies reported a recent increase in cyberattacks targeting banks and factories.
stories.impact: May hurt Nifty: Bank stocks may suffer if cyber breaches lead to extra security costs and loss of customer trust.

stories.headline: Small-cap sell off intensifies as MTF funded positions unwind
stories.summary: The average borrowed money used by traders to buy stocks fell to ₹1.51 lakh crore in October. Investors reduced their borrowed positions in smaller companies due to high interest costs and weak earnings.

stories.headline: Varun Beverages’ Q3 volume surge can’t mask margin pain
stories.summary: Varun Beverages reported a 28.7% rise in sales volume for the September quarter. However, profit margins were compressed due to higher packaging material costs.
stories.impact: May hurt Nifty: Higher packaging costs cut into company profits despite strong drink sales.

stories.headline: Sebi to delist penny stocks: Market regulator plans AI-based surveillance of such firms
stories.summary: Market regulator SEBI plans to use artificial intelligence to identify and remove inactive small companies from stock exchanges. It also plans to announce compliance rules for foreign investors.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Removing inactive firms and improving trading rules helps protect retail investors and increases trust in the market.

stories.headline: Banks seek microloan guarantee extension
stories.summary: IDFC First Bank and small finance banks like AU, Jana, and Suryoday asked the government to extend a small loan guarantee scheme. They set aside guarantee fees expecting the government to reopen the program.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Government guarantees on small loans protect banks against losses from unpaid micro-loans.

stories.headline: Irdai to weigh 650+ responses on insurance commissions
stories.summary: Insurance regulator IRDAI received over 650 responses to its paper proposing tighter limits on agent commissions and business expenses. The regulator will issue draft rules next.
stories.impact: Unclear for Nifty: Limits on agent commissions could reduce business expenses for insurers but might temporarily lower new policy sales.

stories.headline: FPI G-Sec outflows nearly halve to Rs 5,400 crore in October
stories.summary: Foreign investors sold Indian government bonds worth Rs 5,400 crore in October. This amount is nearly half of the bond sales recorded in September.
stories.impact: Little effect on Nifty: A slowdown in foreign selling of government bonds indicates reduced pressure on Indian debt markets.

stories.headline: China Reportedly Discusses Ways to Support Stocks With Banks
stories.summary: China's financial regulators scheduled a meeting with commercial banks and brokerages to discuss ways to support their stock market and halt falling share prices.
stories.impact: Unclear for Nifty: Steps to support Chinese stocks might attract global investment away from India or boost Asian market confidence as a whole.
